Coercion: the env var parses "false" to boolean false. Candidate code: `const auditLog = cfg.features.audit_log || true;`. Supplied observation: config/app.yaml sets `features: { audit_log: false }`, and the running service logs `audit_log=true`.

Candidate code: `const enabled = cfg.cache?.enabled ?? true; const ttl = cfg.cache?.ttl_seconds ?? 300;`. Supplied observations: file sets enabled: false, result false; env CACHE_TTL_SECONDS=0, result 0; key absent, results true and 300. Avoid manufacturing a finding when the specialist threshold is not met.
